page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2a-c1m2.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.u2a family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs powered by AMD EPYC processors operating at a clock speed of 2.25 GHz. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through attached network volumes. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps and does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses. There are no integrated GPUs, making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or parallel computing tasks.

With its 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.u2a-c1m2.8xlarge is structured for compute-heavy workloads that require substantial processing power without demanding massive memory footprints. This hardware profile offers qualitative cost efficiency for applications that scale horizontally across dedicated CPU cores. Suitable workloads include batch processing, web serving, distributed analytics, and CI/CD pipelines.
